notes.content:
The Podcast That Feeds the Funnel 

"One episode link becomes a week of posts, an audio clip in your own voice and tracked links, without anyone scrubbing a timeline."

Research. Repurposing is the whole content strategy for most companies; it is still done by a human scrubbing a timeline, two hours per episode.

Who does this today. A social manager, manually.

1. Paste an Episode Link
        ↓
2. Pull the Transcript
        ↓
3. Find the Five Best Moments (GPT)
        ↓
4. Loop Over → One at a Time
        ↓
5. For Each Moment
        ↓
   ├── Create Trackable Link
   │
   ├── Write Social Post (GPT)
   │
   ├── Create Own-Voice Audio Clip
   │
   └── Create/Trim Video Clip
        ↓
6. Publish
   ├── Instagram
   └── LinkedIn
        ↓
7. Track Results
